\begin{abstract}
In this paper, we investigate field-free switching in Mn3Sn.
Atomistic simulations were performed for a single-domain film.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}
Smith et al. measured the switching current in tilted films.
Bias-free switching was proposed for collinear antiferromagnets~\cite{a}.
Here we implement spin-orbit torque in an atomistic model and show that tilting removes the bias field.

\section{Results}
We simulate reversal at every tilt angle. Reversal completes within 0.3 ns.

\caption{Reversal time against tilt angle. The threshold current was obtained from the simulations.}
